title: Na Reya Ghazi Na Ridawaan
body:
Na reya Ghazi na ridawaan raeyaan
Sani)
Dhiyan Ali diyan Najaf day pasay mu ker kay rondiyan raeyaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Haye bazar ch jad pehla si balwa takeya haye balwa takeya
Kubra tay Sakina Zainab olay parday lae chupdiyan raeyaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Haye darya tou jado qaidi si bhaina langiyan haye bhaina langiyan
Ghazi di lash nu sham e ghareeban kinj guzri dasdiyan raeyaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Haye Shabbir nay naizay tay si Quran perheya haye quran parheya
Chadraan vi safar wich naam e Zahra perh perh kay rondiyan raeyaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Haye rasiyan ch janazay nay aay bhaina akhan haye bhaina akhan
Ghazi day baad nae qasam khuda di veer asi jeundiyan raeyaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Haye raawaan ch wichanday raye si shami kandday haye shami kandday
Phuphiyan qadam qadam putar di raah cho kandeyan nu chundiyan raeyaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Haye pathraan di jado barish si hoi Akbar haye hoi Akbar
Bhaina jhuka kay sir ro ro kay bus naad e Ali perhdiyan raeyaan..
